title: Read and freeze a score region input

common__Id.description: Opaque stable external identifier. A displayed measure number, staff number, or event ordinal is not an identifier. External IDs are not automatically legal SFS aliases: use the returned alias/reference map and TextIdentifier for fragment-local names.

common__Rational.description: Exact canonical rational in quarter-note units where applicable. Integers have no denominator; fractions have positive denominator > 1. Semantic validation additionally requires gcd(abs(n), d)=1. JSON Schema alone cannot enforce reduction; 2/4 is rejected by the semantic validator. No floating-point JSON values, leading zeros, -0, 0/d, or n/1.

common__RevisionId.description: Immutable score revision identifier; never the mutable alias latest.

selection__EventSelector.description: Select these exact event identities before explicitly requested expansions. Unknown IDs are an error, not an empty match.

selection__Filters.description: Intersect supplied filters. Omitted lists mean unrestricted; empty lists are not accepted. Staff means the event's resolved staff at its onset, including local overrides, not its voice's initial default.

selection__MeasureRangeByCount.description: Select count consecutive measures beginning with start_measure_id. A count is resolved only in the pinned revision. Overrun is an error; the result still freezes concrete IDs and boundaries.

selection__MeasureRangeByEnd.description: Select from the start measure to, but not including, the end measure in one declared measure sequence. IDs are stable identities; no arithmetic on printed labels. Both endpoints must belong to the same scope and appear in that order.

selection__SelectionPolicy.description: Resolve the selector, intersect explicit filters, then apply the requested expansions. Expansions may intentionally extend beyond the original time interval, but must not escape explicit part/voice/staff filters: report a policy/filter conflict rather than silently truncate a whole chord/chain. explicit_only never adds grace notes but does not remove explicitly requested grace IDs. with_principal includes attached grace events when their principal is selected. by_anchor uses half-open temporal spans and is not accepted for an unbounded event-ID selector. Return expanded membership explicitly; it does not enlarge the permitted replace_range span.

selection__TimeRangeSelector.description: Half-open [start,end), start < end. Onset: start <= t < end. Overlap: t < end and t+duration > start. Contained: start <= t and t+duration <= end. Overlap selects the entire event, never an implicit clipped fragment. Grace handling is separate.
